paragraphs: I am a Customer & Business Insights Analyst with 4+ years of experience delivering business intelligence and customer analytics across consumer goods and enterprise IT environments.

At PepsiCo I build predictive churn models, RFM-based customer segments and controlled A/B tests. These have reduced quarterly churn by 18%, increased Customer Lifetime Value by 22% and improved conversion rates by 14%.
Earlier, at Hexaware Technologies, I engineered data pipelines and executive dashboards used by 6,000+ global sales users, and tracked $4.9M+ in sales compensation for 2,000+ sales executives.
I am completing an MS in Data Analytics and have earned the Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate.
